yaml_resource.title: Update the Omnibattery Cards YAML resource
yaml_resource.description: Dashboard resources are managed in YAML. Replace all old Omnibattery Cards resource entries with exactly one entry using URL `{url}` and type `module`, then reload Lovelace resources and refresh your browser. Leave other cards unchanged. Automatic registration is paused to avoid loading duplicate scripts. See the repository migration instructions.
